target: acceptance 1 — an unknown value refuses with exit 2, naming BOTH the offending value and the valid set. Naming the offender is what stops a canned message passing.
cmd: e=$("$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" profile "$FIXTURES/profile/banana.md" 2>&1 >/dev/null); c=$?; off=$(printf "%s" "$e" | grep -c "banana"); set=$(printf "%s" "$e" | grep -c "standard, hardened, dark"); printf '{"c":%s,"namesOffender":%s,"namesSet":%s}' "$c" "$off" "$set"
